changelog: New Host Inspector: CS3M now detects which CloudStream build it runs inside - package, version, build hash, install source, target SDK, pre-release vs release, settings UI generation (Compose vs XML), device and layout facts - straight from PackageManager and the host's own resources.

New view inventory: the app's live view trees are captured screen by screen (ids, classes, parent ids, sizes, text, flags), including an observed catalogue of host view ids. It runs automatically on every screen, is bounded, self-throttled and skips CS3M's own views.
Host Inspector page under Settings > System: shows the detected profile, the captured view counts, a clipboard export of the full JSON and a manual capture/clear action.
Anchoring decisions can now be based on observed host surfaces instead of assumptions, which is what made the settings entry fail silently before.
